card.name: Just before a nationality or ethnic adjective
card.fires_on: Small words such as was, by, of, to or for in biographies and history text, right where a nationality or ethnicity word (French, British, African American) is likely to come next.

modes.label: Biography opener
modes.description: The word 'was' after a person's birth and death dates, where a nationality like French or British follows.
modes.example: Michel-Jean Sedaine (July 4, 1719 – May 17, 1797)<< was>> a French dramatist, was born

modes.label: Ethnic or national group context
modes.description: A linking word in text about African American or South African topics, just before a group or national label.
modes.example: considered to be the first novel written<< by>> an African American. It was based on

card.writes: It raises nationality adjectives such as italian, japanese, african and canadian, and lowers US state names.
card.plain: It fires on small words that are about to be followed by a nationality, like 'was a French painter'.
